items.text_th: ใครมีขายมั้ยคะ
items.text_vn: Có ai bán không ạ?
items.text_en: Is anyone selling?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi có ai bán món đang cần không
items.summary_en: Asks whether anyone is selling
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game

items.text_th: ปกติตายตัวแล้วมันจบที่เท่าไรครับผมจบไป64000ใช้เวลาสามวันตาแทบบอด
items.text_vn: Bình thường quay tới mốc bảo đảm thì xong ở khoảng bao nhiêu vậy? Mình tới 64.000 mới xong, mất ba ngày, mỏi mắt muốn mù luôn.
items.text_en: Usually how much does it take to hit the guaranteed reward? I finished at 64,000 after three days, my eyes nearly gave out.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi mọi người quay tới mốc bảo đảm hết bao nhiêu, bản thân tốn 64.000 và ba ngày.
items.summary_en: Asks how much others spent to reach the guaranteed reward; they needed 64,000 and three days.

items.text_th: ทางนี้จบ25000ค่ะ
items.text_vn: Bên mình xong ở 25.000.
items.text_en: I finished at 25,000.
items.summary_vn: Chia sẻ mình tốn 25.000 để tới mốc bảo đảm.
items.summary_en: Shares they reached the guarantee at 25,000.

items.text_th: 40 นิดๆ
items.text_vn: Hơn 40 nghìn một chút.
items.text_en: A bit over 40k.
items.summary_vn: Chia sẻ mình tốn hơn 40 nghìn.
items.summary_en: Shares they spent a bit over 40k.

items.text_th: 15k ดวงล้วนๆ
items.text_vn: 15 nghìn, toàn nhờ hên thôi.
items.text_en: 15k, pure luck.
items.summary_vn: Chỉ tốn 15 nghìn nhờ may mắn.
items.summary_en: Only needed 15k thanks to luck.

items.text_th: 50k ครับ
items.text_vn: 50 nghìn ạ.
items.summary_vn: Chia sẻ mình tốn 50 nghìn.
items.summary_en: Shares they spent 50k.

items.text_th: 30k ใช้รอบละ 500
items.text_vn: 30 nghìn, mỗi lượt dùng 500.
items.text_en: 30k, using 500 per round.
items.summary_vn: Tốn 30 nghìn, mỗi lượt 500.
items.summary_en: Spent 30k at 500 per round.

items.text_vn: Bên mình bấm mỗi lần 10, 50, 100, 250.
items.text_en: I press 10, 50, 100, 250 at a time.
items.summary_vn: Chia sẻ cách bấm quay theo từng mức 10/50/100/250.
items.summary_en: Shares they spin in steps of 10/50/100/250.

items.text_th: หาเพื่อนเล่นเวลานี้ค่ะ เหงามาก
items.text_vn: Tìm bạn chơi giờ này nè, buồn quá.
items.text_en: Looking for someone to play with right now, so lonely.
items.summary_vn: Tìm bạn chơi cùng vì đang buồn.
items.summary_en: Looking for a friend to play with because they feel lonely.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เล่นด้วยครับ
items.text_vn: Mình chơi cùng nha.
items.text_en: I'll play with you.
items.summary_vn: Nhận lời chơi cùng.
items.summary_en: Offers to play together.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: [redacted] เรา แอดมาได้
items.text_vn: [redacted] là mình nè, kết bạn đi.
items.text_en: [redacted] is me, add me.
items.summary_vn: Gửi tên trong game để kết bạn.
items.summary_en: Shares their in-game name to be added as a friend.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: จะเอากลับมาขายอีกมั้ย
items.text_vn: Món này có bán lại nữa không vậy?
items.text_en: Will they bring this back to sell again?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi hộp quay/vật phẩm cũ (cần câu) có quay lại cửa hàng không.
items.summary_en: Asks whether an old gacha item (a fishing rod) will return to the shop.

items.text_th: มีมาเรื่อยๆค่ะ จะมีช่วงเวลาเหมือนก่อนหน้านี้ไม่นานมาแล้วรอบนึง
items.text_vn: Có quay lại hoài mà, cũng giống đợt vừa rồi không lâu có một lần.
items.text_en: It comes back now and then, like the round not long ago.
items.summary_vn: Trả lời là vật phẩm thỉnh thoảng có quay lại.
items.summary_en: Answers that the item returns from time to time.

items.text_th: ปีใหม่มาครับดองเพชรรอได้เลยปีใหม่ตู่วนเพียบปีที่แล้วเลืองไม่ถูกมันเอากลับมาเยอะมาก
items.text_vn: Tết dương lịch là có đó, cứ để dành kim cương mà chờ. Năm mới hộp quay cũ quay lại nhiều lắm, năm ngoái nhiều tới mức chọn không xuể.
items.text_en: It comes at New Year, just save diamonds and wait. Lots of old boxes come back at New Year; last year there were so many you couldn't choose.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên để dành kim cương chờ dịp năm mới vì hộp quay cũ quay lại nhiều.
items.summary_en: Advises saving diamonds for New Year when many old boxes return.

items.text_th: ทางนี้สุ่มเมื่อปีใหม่ที่ผ่านมาค่ะ หมดเพชรเกือบ3พัน เก็บรอเลยยย
items.text_vn: Mình quay hồi năm mới rồi, tốn gần 3 nghìn kim cương. Cứ gom mà chờ nha.
items.text_en: I rolled it last New Year and spent almost 3,000 diamonds. Save up and wait.
items.summary_vn: Kể đã tốn gần 3.000 kim cương quay món này dịp năm mới, khuyên để dành.
items.summary_en: Says they spent almost 3,000 diamonds on it last New Year; advises saving up.

items.text_th: การันตี7000กว่าบวกตั๋วนิดหน่อยถามว่าคุ้มไหมคุ้มนะครับไม่ต้องไปคราฟเบ็ดที่ใช้เพชรฟ้า ปลามง
items.text_vn: Mốc bảo đảm hơn 7.000 cộng thêm ít vé. Hỏi có đáng không thì đáng đó, khỏi phải chế cần câu tốn kim cương xanh, câu cá vương miện (?).
items.text_en: The guarantee is 7,000+ plus a few tickets. Worth it? Yes, you don't have to craft the rod that costs blue diamonds (for crown fish?).
items.summary_vn: Cho biết mốc bảo đảm hơn 7.000 và đánh giá đáng tiền vì khỏi chế cần câu bằng kim cương xanh.
items.summary_en: Says the guarantee is 7,000+ and worth it since you skip crafting the blue-diamond rod.

items.text_th: 400 กว่าซอง กับ 28 ซองค่ะ ของง่ายทั้งคู่ ฟริน 🤤
items.text_vn: Hơn 400 gói với 28 gói, cả hai đều là loại dễ, sướng ghê 🤤
items.text_en: 400-something packs and 28 packs, both the easy kind, so satisfying 🤤
items.summary_vn: Khoe số gói đã mở (hơn 400 và 28 gói) để hoàn thành.
items.summary_en: Shows off the number of packs opened (400+ and 28) to complete it.

items.text_th: อันนี้ทำยังไงค้า
items.text_vn: Cái này làm sao vậy?
items.text_en: How do you do this?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi cách làm được như bài đăng.
items.summary_en: Asks how to do what the post shows.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: มาแนวทางอัปเสียมมั้ยครับ ปกติไม่ค่อยได้ใช้เลยไม่รู้ว่าจะอัปอะไรดี
items.text_vn: Có ai chỉ hướng nâng cấp xẻng không? Bình thường ít dùng nên không biết nên nâng gì.
items.text_en: Any tips on upgrading the shovel? I rarely use it so I don't know what to upgrade.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi nên nâng cấp chỉ số gì cho xẻng đào kho báu.
items.summary_en: Asks which stats to upgrade on the treasure shovel.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: พาว S 1หรือ2 ก็ได้จะได้ขุดที่เดียวขึ้น ที่เหลือจะเอากล่องเก่าหรือตำนานก็ได้ แต่ส่วนตัวชอบตำนานมากกว่า
items.text_vn: Lấy Power S 1 hoặc 2 để đào một chỗ là ra; còn lại chọn hộp cũ hay huyền thoại đều được, riêng mình thích huyền thoại hơn.
items.text_en: Take Power S 1 or 2 so one dig is enough; for the rest pick old box or legendary, I personally prefer legendary.
items.summary_vn: Hướng dẫn nâng Power S và ưu tiên dòng huyền thoại cho xẻng.
items.summary_en: Recommends Power S and the legendary option for the shovel.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ต้าวหมีละ
items.text_vn: Bé gấu kìa!
items.text_en: The little bear!
items.summary_vn: Thích thú với thú cưng gấu sắp ra mắt.
items.summary_en: Excited about the upcoming bear pet.

items.text_th: [redacted] น่ารัก
items.text_vn: [redacted] dễ thương ghê.
items.text_en: [redacted] so cute.
items.summary_vn: Tag bạn và khen thú cưng gấu mới dễ thương.
items.summary_en: Tags a friend and says the new bear pet is cute.

items.text_th:
แบบนี้คงต้องพึ่งดวงแล้วใช้ไหมครับ
อีกใบเดียวเองเกมส์ก็ใจร้ายเกิน
items.text_vn: Vầy chắc phải trông vào hên xui rồi ha? Chỉ còn đúng một thẻ mà game ác quá.
items.text_en: Guess it's all down to luck now, right? Just one card left and the game is too cruel.
items.summary_vn: Than còn thiếu đúng một thẻ để hoàn thành bộ sưu tập, phải trông vào may mắn.
items.summary_en: Complains they are one card short of finishing the collection and must rely on luck.

items.text_th: ของเราก็เหลืออีกใบเดียวค่ะ ใจร้ายสุดๆ การ์ดทองมันส่งให้กันได้ไหมคะ
items.text_vn: Mình cũng còn thiếu một thẻ, ác thật sự. Thẻ vàng có tặng cho nhau được không?
items.text_en: I'm one card short too, so cruel. Can gold cards be sent to each other?
items.summary_vn: Cũng thiếu một thẻ, hỏi thẻ vàng có tặng nhau được không.
items.summary_en: Also one card short; asks if gold cards can be gifted.

items.text_th: นี่อีก2ใบเลยค่ะรีตู้ไปฟ้าไป8-9ตู้แล้ว
items.text_vn: Mình còn thiếu 2 thẻ, quay lại máy thẻ 8–9 lần rồi mà toàn ra xanh.
items.text_en: I'm still 2 cards short, re-rolled the card machine 8-9 times and kept getting blue.
items.summary_vn: Thiếu 2 thẻ dù đã quay lại 8–9 lần, toàn ra thẻ xanh.
items.summary_en: Two cards short after 8-9 re-rolls that only gave blue cards.

items.text_th: ผมก็ขาดใบเดียวรอบแรกด้วยนะ รีไปนับไม่ถ้วน เก็บจากเควสก็เยอะ มันไม่ออกจริงๆ การ์ดทอง5 ดาวมี 4 แบบ 3แบบที่ได้แล้วก็ออกซ้ำอยู่งั้น เหลืออันเดียวที่เราขาดยังไงก็ไม่ออก ไม่เคยเก็บการ์ดไม่ครบมาก่อน ครั้งนี้ครั้งแรก ที่แม้แต่รอบแรกก็ไม่ครบ ทุกที เก็บครบได้2 รอบตลอด
items.text_vn: Mình cũng thiếu một thẻ ngay vòng đầu. Quay lại không đếm xuể, làm nhiệm vụ gom cũng nhiều mà nó không ra thật. Thẻ vàng 5 sao có 4 loại, 3 loại đã có thì cứ ra trùng hoài, còn đúng cái mình thiếu thì sao cũng không ra. Trước giờ chưa từng gom thiếu, lần này là lần đầu ngay cả vòng đầu cũng không đủ, mọi lần mình đều gom đủ 2 vòng.
items.text_en: I'm also one card short in the first round. Re-rolled countless times and got lots from quests, it just won't drop. There are 4 gold 5-star cards; the 3 I have keep repeating and the one I need never shows up. I've never failed to finish before, this is the first time I can't even complete round one; I usually finish 2 rounds.
items.summary_vn: Than thẻ vàng 5 sao còn thiếu không bao giờ ra, chỉ ra trùng; lần đầu không hoàn thành nổi vòng 1.
items.summary_en: Complains the missing gold 5-star card never drops, only duplicates; first time failing to finish round one.

items.text_th: ไม่มาแล้ว ของเรา 3 ใบทอง เปิดซองเปิดตู้การ์ดบ่อยมาก ไม่มาเลย
items.text_vn: Không ra nổi đâu. Mình thiếu 3 thẻ vàng, mở gói mở máy thẻ hoài mà chẳng ra.
items.text_en: It's not coming. I'm missing 3 gold cards, opened packs and the card machine so often and nothing.
items.summary_vn: Thiếu 3 thẻ vàng dù mở gói rất nhiều.
items.summary_en: Missing 3 gold cards despite opening many packs.

items.text_th: ขาดใบเดียว และใบเดียวกันเลย ท้อ….
items.text_vn: Thiếu một thẻ, mà còn đúng cái thẻ giống nhau luôn, nản…
items.text_en: Missing one card, and it's the exact same one, so discouraged…
items.summary_vn: Cũng thiếu đúng thẻ đó, thấy nản.
items.summary_en: Missing the very same card and feeling discouraged.

items.text_th: ของเราเหลือใบ“กอดคอ”
items.text_vn: Mình còn thiếu thẻ “Khoác vai”.
items.text_en: I'm still missing the “Arm around shoulder” card.
items.summary_vn: Cho biết còn thiếu thẻ “Khoác vai”.
items.summary_en: Says they still lack the “Arm around shoulder” card.

items.text_th: ใบเดียวนี่ละรอบที่แล้วผม รีการ์ด 18 ครั้งถึงได้ครบ นรกมาก
items.text_vn: Đúng cái một thẻ đó, đợt trước mình quay lại thẻ 18 lần mới đủ, cực như địa ngục.
items.text_en: That one card — last time I re-rolled 18 times to complete it, pure hell.
items.summary_vn: Kể đợt trước phải quay lại 18 lần mới đủ bộ thẻ.
items.summary_en: Says last time it took 18 re-rolls to complete the set.

items.text_th: ทางนี้เติมเเพ็คการ์ดไปเป็นพัน ถึงจะครบ
items.text_vn: Mình nạp mua gói thẻ cả nghìn mới đủ bộ.
items.text_en: I spent around a thousand on card packs before completing it.
items.summary_vn: Phải nạp cả nghìn mua gói thẻ mới hoàn thành bộ.
items.summary_en: Had to spend about a thousand on card packs to finish.

items.text_th: [redacted] ไม่เคยได้ดีกับใครเขาเลยคะครั้งแรก555
items.text_vn: [redacted] chưa bao giờ trúng đồ ngon như người ta, đây là lần đầu đó haha.
items.text_en: [redacted] I never got anything good like others, this is my first time haha.
items.summary_vn: Vui vì lần đầu quay trúng phần thưởng đáng giá.
items.summary_en: Happy to finally get a good reward for the first time.

items.text_th: เล่นด้วยพี่
items.text_vn: Chơi cùng nha chị.
items.text_en: I'll play with you.
items.summary_vn: Nhận lời làm bạn câu cá.
items.summary_en: Offers to be a fishing buddy.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ชื่อในเกมอะไรหรอคะ
items.text_vn: Tên trong game của bạn là gì vậy?
items.text_en: What's your in-game name?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi tên trong game để kết bạn.
items.summary_en: Asks for their in-game name to add them.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game

items.text_th: เล่นด้วยครับ
items.text_vn: Mình chơi cùng nha.
items.text_en: I'll play with you.
items.summary_vn: Nhận lời chơi cùng.
items.summary_en: Offers to play together.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: อยู่US เล่นได้ครับแค่ตอนโหลด VNG ให้เปลี่ยนภูมิภาคก่อนค่อยโหลดเวลาจะอัพเดตก็เปลี่ยนภูมิภาคไปไทยเหมือนเดิม
items.text_vn: Mình ở Mỹ vẫn chơi được. Lúc tải bản VNG thì đổi khu vực trước rồi mới tải, khi cập nhật thì lại đổi khu vực về Thái Lan như cũ.
items.text_en: I'm in the US and can play. When downloading VNG, switch your store region first; when updating, switch the region back to Thailand again.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi ở Mỹ hướng dẫn đổi khu vực cửa hàng sang Thái Lan để tải và cập nhật bản VNG.
items.summary_en: A player in the US explains switching the store region to Thailand to download and update the VNG version.

items.text_th: วาสนาออเดอร์ดีสุดๆค่ะ ทางนี้เจอแค่1-2 ตั๋วเอง
items.text_vn: Hên đơn hàng ghê, bên mình chỉ gặp 1–2 vé thôi.
items.text_en: You're so lucky with orders, I only got 1-2 tickets.
items.summary_vn: Ganh tị vì người đăng gặp đơn hàng tốt, mình chỉ được 1–2 vé.
items.summary_en: Envies the poster's good orders; they only got 1-2 tickets.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: อ่าวนึกว่าเป็นคนเดียวก็ว่าปลูกตั้งเยอะ อัดสปริงเกอร์ก็เยอะ ไม่ยักษ์เลย
items.text_vn: Ủa, tưởng mỗi mình bị. Trồng cả đống, cắm vòi tưới cũng nhiều mà không ra khổng lồ gì hết.
items.text_en: Oh, I thought it was just me. Planted tons, lots of sprinklers, and nothing turns giant.
items.summary_vn: Cũng bị cây phong không đạt khổng lồ dù cắm nhiều vòi tưới.
items.summary_en: Also can't get giant maples despite many sprinklers.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: 500-1000 กรี๊ดมากกก
items.text_vn: Có 500–1.000 thôi, muốn hét luôn.
items.text_en: Only 500-1,000, I want to scream.
items.summary_vn: Cây phong chỉ đạt 500–1.000, rất bực.
items.summary_en: Maples only reach 500-1,000; very frustrated.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_vn: Hèn gì không lên nổi 1.000. Định trồng bán lấy xu nông trại, tiếc mấy cái vòi tưới ghê.
